City Council
AGENDA
A REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
January 22, 2013
7:00 P.M.
City Hall Council Chambers
24300 Narbonne Avenue
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Councilmember Traina
d.
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS
Presentation by VFW regarding their ongoing activities and presentation of awards.
4.
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
6.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. When addressing the Council, please come to the podium and give your name and address for the record. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a 5 minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
b.
Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Special City Council Meeting held on December 17, 2012 and Regular City Council Meeting held on January 7, 2013. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
Minutes -December 17, 2012 CC Special Meeting
Minutes- January 7, 2013
c.
Approval of Demands
Demands -Staff Report
SCHEDULED MATTERS
8.
COMMISSION APPOINTMENTS Report recommending that appointments be made for one (1) vacancy on the Planning Commission, (2) vacancies on the Traffic and Safety Commission and (1) vacancy on Parks and Recreation Commission.
Presented by City Manager Rock.
Staff report- item #8
ADJOURNMENT
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
minutes_text:
MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
January 22, 2013

1. OPENING CEREMONIES

  a. Call Meeting to Order

A regular meeting of the Lomita City Council was called to order at 7:00 p.m. on Tuesday,
January 22, 2013, in the Council Chambers, Lomita City Hall, 24300 Narbonne Avenue.

  b. Flag Salute

Former Mayor and Councilmember Ken Blackwood led the salute to the flag.

  c. Invocation

Councilmember Traina gave the invocation.

  d. Roll Call

Those responding to roll call by Assistant City Clerk Shumway were COUNCILMEMBERS:
Gazeley, Traina, Sanchez, and Mayor Estrada. Councilmember Savidan was absent. Also
present were City Manager Rock, Assistant City Manager Sugano, Assistant City Attorney
Lauren Langer, Community Services Director McPherron, Public Works Director Damasse,
Administrative Services Director Chavez, and Assistant City Clerk Shumway.

2. APPROVAL OF AGENDA

Councilmember Gazeley moved to approve the agenda. Councilmember Sanchez seconded
the motion, which carried by the following vote:

Roll Call:
AYES: Councilmembers Traina, Gazeley, Sanchez, and Mayor Estrada
NOES: None
ABSENT: Councilmember Savidan

3.  PRESENTATIONS

  Presentation by VFW regarding their ongoing activities and presentation of awards.

Lou Gomez, VFW 1622 Post Commander, presented a certificate of recognition to Deputy Juan
Lara, and provided a check for the Lomita Sheriff’s Station employee fund. Commander Gomez
stated that the VFW is constantly looking to recruit new members, and he invited everyone to
join VFW 1622 and participate in their fundraising activities.

Former Mayor and Councilmember Ken Blackwood, representing the South Bay Lions Club,
stated that their organization supports local organizations, including the Sunshine Kids, through
their fundraising activities. Additionally, Mr. Blackwood recognized park staff of the Lomita Teen
  Page 1 of 3
 Program for their assistance with South Bay Lions Club events, and he presented a check to the
City for the program.

4. CITY MANAGER’S REPORT

City Manager Rock informed those in attendance that the City’s Finance Committee will be
meeting on February 24, 2013. City Manager Rock also announced that he will be attending the
League of City Managers Conference in San Francisco, which will take place on January 30th
through February 1, 2013.

5. ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY
  COUNCIL

Councilmember Gazeley reported that he and Mayor Estrada attended the Board of Directors
Meeting for the Water Replenishing District (WRD) on January 16, 2013.

Councilmember Traina inquired about the repairs to 253rd Street, given that the condition there
was deteriorating. Public Works Director Damasse responded that he would follow up on the
status of the street repairs and report back to the City Council.

Councilmember Sanchez reported that he and Councilmember Gazeley attended the Grand
Opening Ceremony for Western Dental on Pacific Coast Highway, and added that it is a very
nice establishment. Mayor Estrada reported that she attended the swearing-in ceremony for
Carol Kwan of the West Basin Municipal Water District Board.

6. ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

James Thompson, representing the Lomita Chamber of Commerce, announced that the Grand
Opening event for Western Dental was very successful. Mr. Thompson also stated that U.S.
Congresswoman Maxine Waters will be attending the Chamber’s upcoming Annual Installation
and Community Awards Dinner on February 1, 2013, which will start at 6 p.m.; Mr. Thompson
invited members of City Council, City staff, and residents to attend the event.

7. CONSENT AGENDA

Councilmember Traina moved to approve the Consent Agenda.  Councilmember Sanchez
seconded the motion.

Roll Call:
AYES: Councilmembers Traina, Gazeley, Sanchez and Mayor Estrada
NOYS: None
ABSENT: Councilmember Savidan

  a. Motion to Waive Further Reading

  b. Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Special City Council held on December
  17, 2012, and the Regular City Council Meeting held on January 7, 2013. RECOMMEND
  APPROVAL.

  Page 2 of 3
   c. Approval of Demands

  SCHEDULED MATTERS

8.  COMMISSION APPOINTMENTS
  Report recommending that appointments be made for one (1) vacancy on the Planning
  Commission, two (2) vacancies on the Public Safety and Traffic Commission, and one (1)
  vacancy on Parks and Recreation Commission.

Councilmembers Traina, Sanchez, and Mayor Estrada nominated Michael Graf to fill the
vacancy on the Planning Commission.

Michael Graf was appointed to the Planning Commission.

Councilmember Sanchez nominated Donald Thomas to fill one of the vacancies on the Public
Safety and Traffic Commission. Councilmembers Traina, Gazeley, and Mayor Estrada
nominated James Villela to fill one of the vacancies on the Public Safety and Traffic
Commission.

James Villela was appointed to the Public Safety and Traffic Commission.

Councilmembers Gazeley, Traina, and Sanchez nominated Sara Vilan to fill the vacancy on the
Parks and Recreation Commission.

Sara Vilan was reappointed to the Parks and Recreation Commission.

Councilmember Traina and Mayor Estrada nominated Gia Stokes to fill the remaining vacancy
on the Public Safety and Traffic Commission. Councilmembers Sanchez and Gazeley
nominated Donald Thomas to fill the remaining vacancy on the Public Safety and Traffic
Commission. Due to a split vote regarding the remaining appointment to the Public Safety and
Traffic Commission, the appointment to fill the remaining vacancy was moved to the next City
Council Meeting when there is a full quorum.

ADJOURNMENT

Meeting adjourned in memory of Sarah Alarid at 7:17 p.m.

Respectfully Submitted,

__________________________________
Lena Shumway, Assistant City Clerk, CMC
